prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in League City, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1448; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording right now, if that's okay. I'm still having trouble with some things.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was driving through the intersection near League City. I had a green light, I think. Everything is a little fuzzy.

Q: What direction were you traveling, and what happened next?

A: I was heading east. A car came from the left side and hit my driver's side door. The airbag went off and I remember my head snapping against the window.

Q: Did you lose consciousness at any point?

A: I don't think so, but I was dizzy and couldn't stand up straight when the paramedics arrived. They said I might have a concussion.

Q: Have you seen a doctor since the accident?

A: Yes, I went to the emergency room and they confirmed the concussion. I'm supposed to rest and avoid screens for a while. Reading is hard and I get headaches if I look at my phone too long.

Q: Are you currently taking any medications for the injury?

A: Just over-the-counter pain relievers for the headaches. My doctor wants me to follow up next week.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add about the accident?

A: Only that I was careful and didn't see the other car coming. I just want to get better and get my car looked at.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
